name: CATER
summary: 由可组合物体运动生成的合成视频数据集，强调时空关系、动作组合和被遮挡目标的定位，适合研究对象中心的动态表示及长期状态追踪。
license: Dataset and code research terms; verify repository license
wmNote: 精确元数据适合对象级世界状态学习；视觉和动作类型高度程序化，真实域泛化有限。
summaryEn: A synthetic video dataset with compositional object motions and precise metadata, emphasizing spatiotemporal relations, occlusion, and long-term object tracking.
wmNoteEn: Precise state annotations support object-centric dynamics, while procedural visuals and actions limit direct real-world transfer.
